title: Jack-o'-lantern with a smiling face
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='pumpkinGrad' cx='50%' cy='45%' r='55%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ffb347'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#e8730c'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <radialGradient id='glowGrad' cx='50%' cy='50%' r='50%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#fffbb0'/>
      <stop offset='70%' stop-color='#ffdd33'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#ffaa00'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- stem -->
  <path d='M47 22 Q46 12 51 8 Q56 10 55 18 L56 24 Z' fill='#7a5230'/>
  <path d='M50 20 Q50 14 53 11' stroke='#9c6b3f' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- pumpkin body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='56' rx='38' ry='33' fill='url(#pumpkinGrad)'/>

  <!-- pumpkin ridges -->
  <path d='M50 23 Q38 56 50 89' stroke='#c95e08' stroke-width='3' fill='none' opacity='0.7'/>
  <path d='M50 23 Q62 56 50 89' stroke='#c95e08' stroke-width='3' fill='none' opacity='0.7'/>
  <path d='M21 40 Q30 56 21 74' stroke='#ffc266' stroke-width='2.5' fill='none' opacity='0.7'/>
  <path d='M79 40 Q70 56 79 74' stroke='#ffc266' stroke-width='2.5' fill='none' opacity='0.7'/>
  <path d='M12 56 Q30 52 50 56 Q70 60 88 56' stroke='#ffc266' stroke-width='2' fill='none' opacity='0.4'/>

  <!-- glowing carved face -->
  <!-- eyes: triangles -->
  <polygon points='30,44 42,44 36,56' fill='url(#glowGrad)'/>
  <polygon points='58,44 70,44 64,56' fill='url(#glowGrad)'/>

  <!-- nose triangle -->
  <polygon points='47,58 53,58 50,66' fill='url(#glowGrad)'/>

  <!-- smiling mouth -->
  <path d='M26 68 Q32 62 38 68 L44 68 Q50 60 56 68 L62 68 Q68 62 74 68 Q68 86 50 86 Q32 86 26 68 Z' fill='url(#glowGrad)'/>

  <!-- mouth teeth gaps suggested by pumpkin rind -->
  <rect x='37' y='68' width='6' height='5' fill='#e8730c'/>
  <rect x='57' y='68' width='6' height='5' fill='#e8730c'/>

  <!-- glow highlights on eye -->
  <circle cx='35' cy='47' r='1.5' fill='#ffffff' opacity='0.8'/>
  <circle cx='63' cy='47' r='1.5' fill='#ffffff' opacity='0.8'/>
</svg>
